author: Kusha N M

lines: ಪಂಕ ಶಂಕೆಯ ಸರಿಸೆ ಹುಟ್ಟು ಸಾವಿನ ಚಕ್ರ

raw:
ಸುಂಕರೂಪದಿ ಕರ್ಮ ಪಾವತಿಸಿ ಜನಿಸುತಲೆ
ಶಂಕೆಗಳ ಕೂಪದಲಿ ಕನಲಿಪುದು ಜೀವ
ಪಂಕ ಶಂಕೆಯ ಸರಿಸೆ ಹುಟ್ಟು ಸಾವಿನ ಚಕ್ರ
ಶಂಕರನೆ ಸನ್ನಡತೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

ಶ್ರೀ ಶಂಕರ ಜಯಂತಿಯ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು🙏

lines: Paying karma as a toll, a being is born,
and life burns in a well of doubts;
if you push aside the mire of doubt, the wheel of birth and death —
good conduct itself is Śaṅkara, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Written for Śaṅkara Jayanti. We are born paying the price of past karma and trapped in doubt. Right conduct, which clears away doubt and frees us from the cycle of birth and death, is itself Śaṅkara, the giver of peace.
en.note: Posted with greetings for Śrī Śaṅkara Jayanti.
